mapper.insert: insert into tbl_character_equipment (user_id, slot_code, item_code) VALUES (#{userId}, #{slotCode}, #{itemCode}) on duplicate key update item_code = values(item_code)
mapper.select: select b.item_code, b.item_name, b.item_type, b.item_hp, b.item_ap, b.item_dp, b.slot_code, c.slot_name from tbl_character_equipment a join tbl_item b on a.item_code = b.item_code left join tbl_equipment_slot c on b.slot_code = c.slot_code where a.user_id = #{userId} and a.slot_code = #{slotCode}

select b.item_code, b.item_name, b.item_type, b.item_hp, b.item_ap, b.item_dp, b.slot_code, c.slot_name from tbl_character_equipment a join tbl_item b on a.item_code = b.item_code left join tbl_equipment_slot c on b.slot_code = c.slot_code where a.user_id = #{userId}
